title: dryopteris scabra
intro: Dryopteris scabra, commonly known as the scaly male fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris scabra include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These constituents are responsible for the plant's ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anticancer properties.
